papers.abstract: Actions that condition world models are highly heterogeneous, and thus existing action-conditioned world models are typically built for individual action types, fragmenting already limited action-annotated data across separate models. We introduce UniAction, a unified action-conditioning framework that represents any action as a sparse set of action elements, each with a discrete semantic identity and a continuous spatiotemporal grounding coordinate. By mapping these coordinates directly into the pretrained video model's native positional space, UniAction allows heterogeneous actions to condition a shared world model within the same spatiotemporal structure. We further introduce cardinality-calibrated attention to address the bias from differing action representation granularities. We evaluate UniAction on four representative action forms: force, camera control, hand pose, and robot pose. UniAction outperforms conditioning alternatives in action following, and a single jointly trained model surpasses the action-specific experts, showing that heterogeneous action data benefit from unified model and joint training.

analysis.key_results: 在力、相机控制、手部姿态和机器人姿态四种动作形式上，UniAction在动作跟随任务中优于条件化替代方案；联合训练模型超越各动作专属专家模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 统一动作条件框架UniAction，可将任意动作表示为稀疏动作元素集，使异构动作在同一时空结构中条件化共享世界模型。
analysis.method: 将动作表示为离散语义身份和连续时空坐标的稀疏动作元素，映射到预训练视频模型的位置空间，并引入基数校准注意力解决表示粒度偏差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出统一动作条件框架UniAction，将异构动作表示为稀疏动作元素，使多种动作类型可条件化共享世界模型，并提升动作跟随性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接面向世界模型的动作条件统一化，支持机器人动作（机器人姿态）与世界模型训练，对VLA和WAM中的多动作联合建模具有核心方法价值。

papers.abstract: Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mechanisms and principles, yet two major barriers limit their broader potential: limited algorithm reusability and an unclear empirical capability boundary. We introduce RobustRLlib, an algorithm-centric library and benchmark that addresses both challenges. It integrates 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms under a unified interface for substantially improved reusability, together with an enhanced evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world shifts and advanced humanoid and vision-language-action tasks. Systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations provides an up-to-date capability map of current robust RL algorithms, revealing where they remain effective and where substantial robustness gaps persist. As an open-source, user-friendly platform, RobustRLlib offers a reproducible and extensible codebase for applying existing methods to new problems and developing new robust RL algorithms.

analysis.key_results: 在273种扰动配置下的系统评估提供了当前鲁棒RL算法的能力图谱，揭示了哪些算法仍然有效以及重大鲁棒性差距依然存在。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RobustRLlib，一个算法中心化的库与基准，统一接口集成17种代表性鲁棒在线、离线与安全RL算法，并提供增强的评估平台，覆盖多样真实扰动及先进的类人机器人与视觉-语言-动作任务。
analysis.method: 通过统一接口集成17种代表性鲁棒RL算法，并构建增强的评估平台，系统化地在273种扰动配置下评估算法鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文介绍了一个统一的鲁棒强化学习算法库与基准RobustRLlib，集成了17种鲁棒RL算法并提供了增强的评估平台，以评估算法在真实世界扰动和VLA任务下的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作是一个鲁棒RL的算法库和基准，其评估平台中包含了视觉-语言-动作任务，因此间接涉及VLA任务的鲁棒性评估，但核心主题并不是VLA或WAM本身，而是鲁棒RL算法的统一与评估。

papers.abstract: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes. We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Rynn-VP and Rynn-GEU for long-horizon visual planning and anticipatory reasoning. Experiments show that RynnUnify achieves the highest average embodied understanding score among the evaluated unified multimodal models and improves the Rynn-VP overall score by 9.75 points over Cosmos 3 Nano. Its agentic extension improves the Rynn-GEU average by 6.0 points over direct reasoning, while the world-action extension achieves 51.5\% success on 20 selected composite RoboCasa365 tasks and 46.7\% average success across three real-robot tasks. Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.

analysis.key_results: 在统一多模态模型中具身理解得分最高；Rynn-VP总体得分比Cosmos 3 Nano高9.75分；代理扩展比直接推理平均提高6.0分；世界-行动扩展在20个选定的RoboCasa365任务上成功率达51.5%，在三个真实机器人任务上平均成功率为46.7%。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform well on robotic manipulation, yet remain brittle once their own actions carry them into states their training data barely covers. Recovering from such failures usually requires recovery demonstrations, policy retraining, or a separate model at inference time. We introduce Backtrack, a lightweight failure detection and recovery mechanism for frozen VLAs that needs none of these. A small failure prediction head, trained only on outcome-labeled rollouts of the frozen policy, reads the VLA's existing internal representations to estimate whether the current episode will fail. When the predicted failure probability exceeds a threshold, a controller pauses the policy, retraces the arm's recently achieved motion, and hands control back to the unchanged policy so it can retry from an earlier configuration. The head adds only 0.48-0.88% to the policy's parameter count. We evaluate Backtrack on LIBERO with three VLAs spanning two action-generation families: SmolVLA and $\pi$0.5, which use flow-matching action experts, and the autoregressive $\pi$0-FAST. On LIBERO-Long, the suite of long-horizon multi-step tasks and the one on which all three policies fail most often, Backtrack reduces each policy's failure rate by 19-48%, raising success by up to 7.4 percentage points; on the three shorter suites, where control success is already 85-99%, its effect is smaller. On MetaWorld, all twelve controller configurations tested with SmolVLA improve on the unassisted policy.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上，Backtrack将三种VLA的失败率降低19-48%，在LIBERO-Long上成功率最高提升7.4个百分点；在MetaWorld上，所有12种控制器配置均优于未辅助策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Backtrack：一种无需恢复演示、策略重训练或额外推理模型的轻量故障检测与恢复机制，仅训练一个小型故障预测头即可使冻结VLA从失败状态中恢复。
analysis.method: 在冻结VLA内部表示上训练一个小型故障预测头，当预测失败概率超过阈值时，控制器暂停策略、回退机械臂最近的运动轨迹，然后交还控制权让原策略从更早状态重试。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Backtrack，一种用于冻结VLA模型的轻量故障检测与恢复机制，通过预测失败概率并回退动作轨迹来提升机器人操作任务的鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can adapt to local human intervention, while federated learning can combine distributed robot experience without pooling raw records. We examine their prospective intersection: sharing adaptations derived from diverse human corrections across tasks, environments, people, and robot embodiments. Corrections differ in modality, safety semantics(urgency, behavioral scope, etc.), and privacy sensitivity. A shared update that improves mean task success may suppress a rare safety intervention or produce an unsafe response on another robot. We argue for three requirements: preserve the context and uncertainty of multimodal corrections when deciding what to share; assess candidate updates in each receiving robot's closed loop before deployment; and evaluate leakage alongside retention of safety-critical evidence. Immediate, legible defensive behavior remains necessary during human interaction. We offer counterexamples and a falsifiable evaluation agenda, not experimental results.

analysis.method: 通过反例和可证伪的评估议程论证联邦VLA适配中共享更新所需的设计要求，未给出具体算法或实验。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but its cost is dominated by autoregressive rollout generation, which can exceed 70% of training time. Existing speculative-decoding methods are poorly suited to this setting: model-based drafters consume scarce GPU memory and may become misaligned as the policy evolves, while existing model-free methods do not explicitly exploit repetition across training epochs. We observe that recent rollouts of the same prompt provide a high-quality, self-updating draft source. Based on this insight, we propose NgramRL, a per-prompt n-gram drafter constructed from bounded recent rollout history. NgramRL requires no auxiliary model, drafter training, or persistent GPU-resident drafter state, while target-model verification preserves the rollout distribution. To hide CPU cache lookup and scheduling, we further introduce an adaptive fan-out prefetcher that predicts likely verification outcomes (j, b), consisting of the accepted draft length j and target-emitted continuation token b. A causal budget allocator concentrates prefetches on high-probability outcomes, while uncovered outcomes fall back to sequential lookup without changing committed tokens. Across two model families and three reasoning and structured-generation workloads, NgramRL commits 3.60-7.77 tokens per target-model forward in the warm-cache regime, up to 1.99x more than SuffixDecoding and 7.0x more than prompt-lookup decoding. On Spider, the prefetcher covers 96.6% of Qwen3-8B outcomes at a candidate budget of 16 and improves measured rollout throughput by 1.38x over synchronous NgramRL, approaching its 1.40x overlap ceiling.

analysis.key_results: 在两种模型家族和三种推理及结构化生成工作负载上，NgramRL在热缓存状态下每个目标模型前向提交3.60-7.77个token，比SuffixDecoding最多高1.99倍，比提示查找解码高7.0倍；在Spider上，预取器在候选预算16时覆盖Qwen3-8B结果的96.6%，并将实测回滚吞吐量比同步NgramRL提高1.38倍，接近1.40倍的重叠上限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出NgramRL，一种基于有限近期回滚历史的每提示N-gram草稿器，无需辅助模型或草稿训练，并通过目标模型验证保持回滚分布；同时提出自适应扇出预取器来隐藏CPU缓存查找和调度延迟。
analysis.method: 构建每提示的N-gram草稿器，利用有界近期回滚历史；目标模型验证保证分布一致性；自适应扇出预取器预测验证结果(j, b)并因果分配预取预算。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种利用近期回滚历史构建每提示N-gram草稿的投机解码方法，以加速强化学习后训练中的自回归生成，无需辅助模型或训练。

papers.abstract: Quantitative and dense task progress feedback is essential for robotic manipulation across data curation, policy evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Existing progress annotations often rely on sparse keyframe markings derived from subjective manual judgments, limiting their scalability and cross-task consistency, particularly in long-horizon manipulation. To overcome these challenges, we propose action-aware quantification, a unified progress specification that decomposes long-horizon trajectories into object-level subtasks via a vision-language model (VLM) and assigns weighted action credits to capture fine-grained execution dynamics. Using VLM auto-labeling and human calibration, we construct an 800+ hour training video dataset and LOOM, a long-horizon progress benchmark containing 19,618 human-calibrated evaluation frames. To model these dense progress dynamics, we introduce NimCritic, a predictive progress critic trained via Joint Video-Progress Learning. We further incorporate Historical Progress Perturbation to mitigate sequential drift, and design a contrastive Video-Progress Alignment objective that bridges asymmetric expert streams by mutually grounding intermediate visual dynamics and denoised progress trajectories. NimCritic matches or outperforms state-of-the-art process reward models (PRMs) on the established Video Progress Benchmark (VPB) and LOOM, surpassing GVL (GPT-6-Sol) on VPB by about 65% in terminal success accuracy (TSA). On the large-scale RoboArena policy evaluation benchmark, it also retrieves human-selected successful rollouts with about 97% overall recall. These results establish action-aware quantification as a scalable foundation for dense progress feedback in robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: NimCritic 在 Video Progress Benchmark (VPB) 和 LOOM 上与最先进过程奖励模型相当或更优；在 VPB 上终端成功准确率（TSA）比 GVL (GPT-6-Sol) 高约 65%；在 RoboArena 策略评估基准上，以约 97% 的总召回率检索人工选择的成功 rollout。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出动作感知量化（action-aware quantification）作为统一的进度规范，构建 800+ 小时训练视频数据集和 LOOM 基准（19,618 帧人工校准），并开发 NimCritic 预测进度评论家，整合 Joint Video-Progress Learning、Historical Progress Perturbation 和对比 Video-Progress Alignment。
analysis.method: 利用 VLM 自动标注和人工校准，将长时程轨迹分解为对象级子任务并赋予加权动作信用；训练 NimCritic 采用 Joint Video-Progress Learning、Historical Progress Perturbation 和对比 Video-Progress Alignment。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出动作感知量化方法，通过 VLM 将长时程轨迹分解为对象级子任务并赋予加权动作信用，训练 NimCritic 模型实现密集进度反馈。

papers.abstract: Unrecognized anomalies in critical infrastructure can rapidly cascade into catastrophic physical or operational failures. Current anomaly detection approaches often rely on direct access to the monitored system by utilizing onboard sensors, such as motor encoders, to detect anomalous states. However, legacy hardware often lacks these sensors, or strict security protocols may prohibit access altogether. We therefore present AWARE, a world model framework that is capable of anomaly detection using only external camera monitoring via system dynamics estimation and state prediction. Evaluated across 240 real-world robotic crane trajectories, including payload collisions and motor degradations, AWARE demonstrates a 26% improvement in anomaly classification over our strongest baseline under noisy, camera-only state estimation. Furthermore, the inferred dynamics parameter can be decoded to identify the source of faults, localizing the degrading motor with 88% accuracy.

analysis.key_results: 在包含有效载荷碰撞和电机退化的 240 条真实机器人起重机轨迹上，AWARE 在仅摄像头状态估计的噪声条件下，异常分类性能比最强基线提升 26%，故障电机定位准确率达 88%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个仅依赖外部摄像头监控、通过系统动力学估计与状态预测实现异常检测的世界模型框架 AWARE，并能在噪声条件下定位故障源。
analysis.method: 利用外部摄像头监测进行系统动力学估计和状态预测，构建世界模型；从推断的动力学参数中解码故障来源。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 AWARE 框架，通过仅使用外部摄像头监控和系统动力学估计来构建世界模型，实现对机器人异常状态的检测与故障定位。

papers.abstract: The pace of a robot demonstration is often determined by the teleoperator rather than by the task itself. As a result, the same motion can appear at widely different speeds across demonstrations, and policies trained on such data may inherit operator-specific timing along with task behavior. We propose to learn a speed prior directly from large-scale demonstration data. Given a task instruction, a motion path and the images along it, it predicts a distribution over execution speed along the path, from which a chosen quantile defines a consistent clock for retiming each demonstration. Existing methods derive the acceleration signal from the very data they accelerate, so each new task costs another fit, annotation, or pair of predefined rates. A single trained speed prior instead covers every task in a corpus. We fit a speed prior on both robot teleoperation data and handheld demonstrations in which a human arm, rather than a robot arm, moves the gripper, and use it to retime robot demonstrations to the handheld pace before fine-tuning a vision-language-action policy. For execution, we pair the policy with a real-time optimal-control layer that tracks predicted action chunks under robot constraints using the predicted pace. On 120 RoboLab tasks, policies fine-tuned on our learned clocks succeed more often and move with up to half the jerk compared with policies fine-tuned on the original demonstration timing and uniformly accelerated to the same speed. On a real robot, our policy stacks cups in 3.50s, 1.72$\times$ faster than the default policy's 6.02s while succeeding as often, in 29 of 30 trials. Videos and further material are available at https://mllab.snu.ac.kr/projects/learned_speed_prior.

papers.abstract: Zero-shot object navigation requires an embodied agent to choose where to search while retaining evidence from previous observations. HGWM couples an LLM-generated room-anchor prior with persistent spatial-semantic memory. A coarse stage assigns visual-semantic scores to candidate headings on a 0-10 scale; a fine stage measures symbolic compatibility between observed objects, room context, and the goal prior. Phase-dependent fusion combines these scores with an LLM direction recommendation before local action selection. On HM3D v0.1, the reported HGWM configuration achieves 62.6% success rate (SR) and 31.5% success weighted by path length (SPL), compared with 58.1% and 31.2% for WMNav. On MP3D, the corresponding values are 46.8% and 17.9%, compared with 45.4% and 17.2%. The results indicate higher success point estimates and modest path-efficiency gains. On HM3D v0.2, the full model obtains 74.4% SR and 31.9% SPL. Additional component ablations reduce SR by 0.9-2.3 percentage points and SPL by 0.6-1.5 points. These are author-reported aggregate measurements. The accompanying implementation repairs pass offline tests; episode-level rerun records are not available. Evaluation is confined to simulation.

analysis.limitations: 评估仅限于仿真，无episode级重跑记录，部分实现仅通过离线测试。

papers.abstract: Ultrasound imaging is highly operator-dependent, motivating robotic systems that reproduce expert scanning skills consistently. These skills involve coordinated interpretation of anatomical landmarks, ultrasound images, and probe-tissue interactions that are difficult to encode in hand-designed control strategies. Imitation learning offers an alternative, but its observation and action representations should reflect the anatomically structured nature of scanning. We propose an anatomy-anchored imitation-learning framework that combines anatomy-guided probe placement with learned ultrasound navigation. The placement module identifies a task-specific anatomical starting point from external visual observations and establishes the initial probe pose as the reference frame for scanning. A flow-based policy then generates scanning motions from anchor-relative probe poses, ultrasound images, probe-mounted camera views, and contact forces, while a termination head predicts task completion. This avoids continuous reliance on third-person vision and reduces dependence on the robot-patient configuration. A handheld acquisition platform enables multimodal demonstrations to be collected during natural freehand scanning without a robot. On 16 unseen participants, task success reaches 96%, 94%, 88%, and 94% for kidney, gallbladder, and liver standard-plane acquisition and radial artery sweeping, respectively. Compared with a fine-tuned pi_0 model, success on the abdominal tasks improves by 10-42 percentage points, with lower time-to-target, peak contact force, and trajectory jerk. Ablations support the complementary roles of anatomical anchoring, egocentric vision, and force feedback. End-to-end trials with automatic placement achieve 90-100% success, and the policies transfer without retraining to a second robot with 83-100% success.

analysis.key_results: 在16名未见参与者上，肾脏、胆囊、肝脏标准平面采集和桡动脉扫查的任务成功率分别达96%、94%、88%、94%；与微调的pi_0模型相比，腹部任务成功率提高10-42个百分点，且到达时间、峰值接触力和轨迹抖动更低；自动放置端到端试验成功率90-100%，策略无重训练迁移至第二台机器人成功率为83-100%。

papers.abstract: Adversarial sharpness penalty per iteration of a base optimizer, known as sharpness-aware minimization (SAM), is an accepted technique to improve generalization in deep learning. Recently, Muon has emerged as a dominant optimization algorithm for training large language models (LLMs). It achieves lower sample complexity for heavy-tailed gradient updates - a phenomenon common in LLM training. However, sharpness penalties with Muon updates are yet largely unexplored in the literature. Moreover, the behavior of SAM under heavy-tailed noise is unknown both theoretically and empirically. A potential reason for this gap is the additional cost of extra gradient computation per iteration for penalty perturbations in SAM, which becomes prohibitive for LLMs. This paper introduces Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithm (SOMA) to combine a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded perturbation scheme with the Muon algorithm. The key idea is to use stale (purely) stochastic gradient noise for adversarial perturbations. Theoretically, we show that SOMA's sample complexity is invariant to the perturbation direction. We provide explorations and insights into SOMA's robustness to heavy-tailed gradient noise. We extensively explore SOMA's efficacy in (a) mitigating quality degradation due to post-training quantization, and (b) catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning of LLMs.

analysis.key_results: 摘要未说明具体数值结果，但声称展示了SOMA在缓解训练后量化质量退化和微调时的灾难遗忘方面的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithm (SOMA)，将基于陈旧随机梯度噪声的对抗扰动与Muon优化器结合，并在理论上证明了样本复杂度对扰动方向不变。
analysis.method: 使用陈旧随机梯度噪声作为对抗扰动，与Muon（正交化动量）优化算法相结合，形成SOMA。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出SOMA，将计算高效的锐度感知扰动与Muon优化器结合，以提升大语言模型训练后的量化鲁棒性和微调时的抗灾难遗忘能力。

papers.abstract: A failed vision-language-action (VLA) rollout does not imply that every action contributed to failure. Yet in group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), a single trajectory-level advantage is assigned to all actions in a rollout. Potentially useful recovery attempts can thus be penalized alongside the errors they aim to correct. Ideal stopping conditions for failure feedback are characterized using success-probability and policy-score martingales. At these stops, the removed gradient contribution has zero conditional expectation given the retained information. Truncation therefore preserves the expectation of a reference GRPO group-gradient estimator and can reduce its covariance. One such stop occurs when the conditional probability of success is zero, motivating error and recovery cues for selecting candidate feedback boundaries. Martingale GRPO (MART-GRPO) is introduced with a vision-language model (VLM) for event-guided truncation. The VLM is fine-tuned on our annotated training set using low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The last visible error without observed recovery is localized by the frozen VLM in complete rollout videos. Failure feedback is retained through the selected error interval and removed afterward, while successful-rollout loss terms and original loss normalization are preserved. For retrospective boundaries, changes in expectation and variance are analyzed to assess departures from ideal stopping. Experiments with OpenVLA-OFT on RoboTwin 2.0 show that MART-GRPO improves success rates over full-trajectory GRPO across multiple tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin 2.0上使用OpenVLA-OFT的实验表明，MART-GRPO相比全轨迹GRPO在多项任务上提高了成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MART-GRPO，通过鞅停止理论和VLM事件引导截断，在GRPO优化中选择性地保留失败反馈，改善VLA策略学习。
analysis.method: 利用成功概率和策略得分的鞅来刻画理想停止条件；使用微调VLM定位最后可见错误且无恢复的区间，在该区间内保留失败反馈，之后截断；保留成功轨迹损失项和原始损失归一化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出MART-GRPO方法，利用成功概率鞅和VLM识别失败轨迹中的错误区间，仅在该区间内施加惩罚，从而改进VLA策略优化。

papers.abstract: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction. We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL), which establishes effective MLLM latent use as a shared prerequisite and then targets the two capabilities with complementary learning signals. First, latent-only generator grounding trains the DiT with a frozen MLLM and connector, strengthening the DiT's use of MLLM latents for generation. Second, for factor-aware control, paired videos specify a target-factor change and non-target preservation, and factor-span replacement trains the DiT to realize this relationship in its output. Third, for temporal inference, text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it. This final stage trains limited-input representations for generation while retaining complete-observation reconstruction as a complementary training mode. Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks (i.e., sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL's contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination.

analysis.key_results: 在三个电影级视频生成任务（稀疏到视频、因子感知编辑、多镜头生成）上，FAPL 持续优于基线方法，并验证了其在 MLLM 特征利用、时序控制和因子协调方面的贡献。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出因子感知预测学习（FAPL）框架，通过潜变量生成器接地、因子跨度替换和生成导向的时序推理训练，使多模态大语言模型潜变量可实际用于视频生成，并同时实现稀疏时序推断与因子感知控制。
analysis.method: FAPL 包含三个阶段：1) 冻结 MLLM 与连接器，仅训练 DiT 以加强其利用 MLLM 潜变量的能力；2) 使用配对视频进行因子跨度替换训练，实现因子感知控制；3) 冻结已训练的 DiT，优化 MLLM 与连接器，以训练适应稀疏输入的表示，同时保留完整观测重建作为互补模式。

papers.abstract: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

papers.abstract: Many language-based applications need a probability distribution over a small set of decisions rather than an open-ended response. We present Chinese Decision, a family of Chinese-language decision models that adapts pretrained causal language models to this interface. Each question is compiled into a shared instruction-and-candidate prompt; a single forward pass reads the final-position logits of the candidate letters and normalizes them over the valid options, without autoregressive answer generation. The interface covers Boolean judgments, categorical choices, and ordinal scores. We report three completed members built on Qwen3.5 0.8B, 2B, and 4B backbones, each trained for one epoch on the same 13.048 million decisions and released with a validation-fitted temperature and a Q8_0 quantization. On the full 307,900-decision CJ-Bench, the 4B model reaches 85.97% overall accuracy, 75.69% general-domain accuracy, and 84.00% average accuracy across medicine, law, and finance with a single checkpoint, above every reported baseline in each domain, at 1.00% expected calibration error. Between the 2B and 4B members, which share data, objective, and minimum batch, parent-clustered paired bootstrap intervals show gains in all four domains, largest in the two low-resource domains (+8.5 and +7.1 points), whereas the 2B gain over 0.8B in law is not statistically resolved. Analyses of the stored predictions further show that a single global temperature lowers pooled calibration error while worsening some domains, that larger members rank their own errors better for selective prediction, and that merging and quantization each change 0.4-1.1% of top-1 predictions while leaving aggregate metrics nearly unchanged. All comparisons rest on single training runs and imported baselines.

analysis.key_results: 4B 模型在 CJ-Bench 上达到 85.97% 总体准确率、75.69% 通用域准确率、医学/法律/金融平均 84.00%，在所有域上超过报告基线，校准误差为 1.00%；2B 与 4B 比较在四个域均有显著提升，低资源域提升最大；2B 与 0.8B 在法律域差异不显著。

papers.abstract: A robot generalist must interpret a scene, act on it, and satisfy every condition of a task. How far do frontier vision-language models (VLMs) meet these demands? We introduce Embodied Agent Arena, evaluating ten VLM agents across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. Its 1,000 cases combine 32 established sources with GeoProbe, our 168-case benchmark for camera, motion, depth, and scale estimation. A minimal harness leaves task decisions to the model through source-native interfaces. Closed-weight models lead all five domains, whereas open-weight VLMs show useful spatial reasoning but substantially lower planning and manipulation success. Beneath these averages, similar geometric errors conceal different scale and shape distortions, and valid region estimates need not identify usable action points. During execution, agents can achieve early subgoals yet lose object control, bind an action to the wrong receiving region, or stop before the required physical state holds. Additional computation does not uniformly resolve these failures: code repair can restore execution without completing the task, while self-review can reverse correct judgments. Failure costs also differ: the strongest planners concentrate failed-token expenditure in prolonged body-control tasks, whereas other models fail broadly across procedures. Matched traces show how successful recovery uses feedback to restore a missing prerequisite and advance the remaining task.

analysis.key_results: 闭源模型在五个领域全面领先；开源 VLM 具备一定空间推理能力，但在规划与操作上成功率显著更低；相似几何误差可能掩盖不同尺度与形状失真；有效区域估计不一定对应可用动作点；执行中可出现丢失物体控制、绑定动作到错误接收区域或提前停止等情况；额外计算并不总能解决失败，代码修复可能恢复执行但未完成任务，自我审查可能逆转正确判断；失败成本分布差异显著，最强规划器的失败 token 主要消耗在长时间身体控制任务中。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Embodied Agent Arena 基准，并完成对十种前沿 VLM 智能体在五大能力域的实证评测。
analysis.method: 构建包含 1000 个案例的评测基准，结合 32 个现有数据源与新提出的 GeoProbe（168 个相机、运动、深度和尺度估计案例），以源生接口的最小化测试框架评测 VLM 智能体。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过 Embodied Agent Arena 综合评测十种 VLM 智能体在几何、空间推理、可供性、任务规划与操作等五大领域的机器人通才能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接评估前沿 VLM 作为机器人通才（即 VLA 候选）的综合能力，涵盖操作、规划、空间推理等核心方向，对本站 VLA 与机器人学习主题具有高度参考价值。

papers.abstract: Model-predictive control with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provides a strong zero-shot goal-reaching planner, but it is only effective over short planning horizons. Hierarchical extensions attempt to bridge this gap by learning a macro planner to predict intermediate latent sub-goals to guide the micro planner. In this work, we demonstrate that unconstrained latent sub-goal prediction is fundamentally flawed. A rigorous evaluation reveals that leading hierarchical macro planners routinely emit physically unrealisable sub-goals. To resolve this, we introduce Metro-WM, a hierarchical framework that issues sub-goals by retrieving genuine states from prior experience rather than generating ungrounded latent vectors. Specifically, Metro-WM constructs a graph whose vertices are observed frames from offline expert demonstrations or random-action trajectories, allowing frames from different episodes to be connected and stitched into routes to the goal. Planning over the full graph also makes the system highly robust to execution errors: if the micro planner drifts off course, Metro-WM instantly finds a new optimal path from the current state. Our experiments show that Metro-WM achieves superior long-horizon success rates of up to 37.33 percentage points over the strongest hierarchical baseline on the same world model while being up to 10.9 times faster, requiring both 13-56 times less offline compute and fewer tuned hyperparameters. Additional analysis reveals that Metro-WM frequently finds shorter paths than the offline demonstrations, outperforms an oracle relying on the query's own demonstration on most benchmarks, and maintains robust performance under extremely sparse dataset conditions.

analysis.key_results: 在相同世界模型上，比最强层次基线成功率高最多37.33个百分点，速度快10.9倍，离线计算减少13-56倍，且超参数更少；经常找到比离线演示更短的路径，在大多数基准上优于依赖查询自身演示的oracle，并在极稀疏数据下保持鲁棒性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Metro-WM框架，通过在图结构上检索真实状态而非生成潜在子目标，解决了层次化潜在规划中子目标不可实现的问题，并提升了长视程规划的效率和鲁棒性。
analysis.method: 构建顶点为观测帧的图，连接不同回合的帧以形成通往目标的路径；规划在整个图上进行，当微规划器偏离轨迹时可即时重新规划。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Metro-WM提出一种层次化世界模型规划框架，通过从过往经验中检索真实状态作为子目标，解决了现有层次化潜在规划中子目标不可实现的问题，实现了高效长视程规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文核心是机器人世界模型的长视程规划，直接涉及世界模型中的规划与子目标选择，属于WAM与机器人学习核心领域。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit rich semantic representations from pretrained Vision-Language Models, yet fine-tuning on limited robot demonstrations degrades this structure and undermines generalization. A fundamental question therefore arises: what constitutes a good action representation? Inspired by the mirror neuron theory's insight that observation and execution share an intention-level encoding, we examine whether a robot's action representations preserve the semantic structure captured by pretrained encoders. Systematic probing confirms that this structure erodes during finetuning, and that its quality synchronizes with both task success and out-of-distribution generalization. We further introduce a plug-and-play method that anchors action representations to a semantic manifold while decomposing representations into a shared semantic channel and a private channel, all discarded at inference, leaving the deployed model unchanged. Validated on different VLA backbones across simulation and real-world benchmarks, our method yields up to +18.7% on real-world in-distribution tasks and +21.5% on out-of-distribution generalization.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实世界基准上，使用不同 VLA 主干网络验证，方法在真实世界分布内任务上提升高达 +18.7%，分布外泛化提升高达 +21.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种即插即用的语义锚定方法，将动作表征分解为共享语义通道和私有通道，并在推理时全部丢弃，从而在保持部署模型不变的同时改善泛化；同时通过系统性探测揭示了动作表征语义结构在微调过程中的退化及其与任务成功率和分布外泛化的同步关系。
analysis.method: 在训练阶段将动作表征锚定到预训练语义流形，并分解为共享语义通道和私有通道，推理时不使用这些额外结构；采用探测分析来评估语义保持程度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文探讨了机器人视觉语言动作模型在微调后动作表征的语义结构退化问题，并提出一种在训练阶段将动作表征锚定到语义流形的方法，在不改变部署模型的情况下提升泛化性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA 模型的动作表征学习进行改进，属于视觉语言动作模型的核心研究主题。所提出的语义锚定方法在不改变部署模型的前提下提升泛化能力，对机器人策略学习和高效推理均具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive performance on diverse embodied tasks. However, deploying VLA models on low-power onboard devices, such as the Jetson Orin, remains challenging due to their high computational complexity, which leads to substantial inference latency and low control frequency. Asynchronous inference can partially mask this latency by parallelizing action execution and subsequent inference, but it introduces two critical issues: perception-execution misalignment and long reaction time. In this paper, we propose EagleVLA, a method for efficient VLA deployment on onboard devices via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Correction. To address misalignment, we train a lightweight future correction module that predicts future environment representations, allowing the action expert to predict actions from the future time step. To reduce reaction time, we introduce confidence-based scheduling optimization that adaptively balances VLM and action expert invocations. We also build a llama.cpp-based inference engine tailored for onboard VLA deployment, with system-level optimizations including CUDA graph reuse, GPU-resident intermediate buffering, and flow unrolling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EagleVLA achieves 14.71x and 9.20x improvements in control frequency compared with naive PyTorch and vla.cpp on Jetson Orin, while outperforming VLASH by 14.8% in success rate on LIBERO benchmark. The code of our asynchronous algorithm is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/EagleVLA, and our efficient llama.cpp-based inference engine is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/EagleVLA-Edge.

analysis.key_results: 在 Jetson Orin 上，与朴素 PyTorch 和 vla.cpp 相比，控制频率分别提升了 14.71 倍和 9.20 倍；在 LIBERO 基准上成功率比 VLASH 高 14.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 EagleVLA 方法，通过训练轻量级未来校正模块解决感知-执行不对齐问题，并引入基于置信度的调度优化来减少反应时间，同时构建了针对机载 VLA 部署优化的 llama.cpp 推理引擎。
analysis.method: 前瞻对齐异步校正：训练未来校正模块预测未来环境表示，使动作专家从未来时间步预测动作；基于置信度的调度优化自适应平衡 VLM 和动作专家调用；系统级优化包括 CUDA 图复用、GPU 驻留中间缓冲和流程展开。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: EagleVLA 通过前瞻对齐异步校正和基于置信度的调度优化，在 Jetson Orin 上实现 VLA 模型的高效机载部署，显著提升控制频率和任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作以 VLA 模型为中心，直接解决 VLA 在低功耗机载设备上的高效推理问题，通过异步校正和系统优化提升实时控制性能，与 VLA 主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Action reasoning in egocentric video requires capturing fine-grained transitions of hand-object interactions, a task where general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle when operating directly on raw pixels. We propose to decouple visual perception from symbolic reasoning by converting videos into Temporal Action Graphs. In a multi-stage prompting pipeline, we first generate dense natural language narratives over short temporal windows as a semantic bottleneck, then formalize them into structured, open-vocabulary graph representations. On the EGTEA and Epic-Kitchens-100 datasets, the symbolic representation unlocks efficient in-context learning: few-shot graph demonstrations yield substantial accuracy gains over zero-shot frame-based inference. Even in the zero-shot setting, graph-based reasoning remains competitive with pixel-based inference despite potential pretraining contamination favoring the latter. Across 11 open-weight VLMs from 6 model families ranging from 2B to 235B parameters, our findings indicate that current VLMs are more effective as symbolic reasoners than as direct visual observers. By projecting video into the language domain, we provide a scalable, fine-tuning-free alternative to end-to-end approaches that better leverages these models' latent reasoning strengths. The code will be made public.

analysis.key_results: 在EGTEA和Epic-Kitchens-100数据集上，少样本图示范比零样本基于帧的推理获得显著准确率提升；在11个开放权重VLMs（2B到235B，6个模型家族）上验证了图推理在零样本下仍具竞争力，表明当前VLMs更擅长符号推理而非直接视觉观察。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未明确说明论文局限性，仅提及潜在的预训练污染有利于基于像素的推理。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出将视频转换为时序动作图（Temporal Action Graphs）的表示，并在多阶段提示流水线中利用该符号表示实现高效的上下文学习，显著优于基于像素的零样本推理。
analysis.method: 多阶段提示流水线：首先生成密集自然语言叙述作为语义瓶颈，再将其形式化为结构化、开放词汇的图表示；在EGTEA和Epic-Kitchens-100数据集上进行少样本上下文学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出将第一视角视频解耦为视觉感知与符号推理，通过多阶段提示生成时序动作图，提升VLMs在动作识别中的零样本和少样本性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于第一视角动作识别，属于视觉语言模型在具身场景中的应用，其方法强调解耦感知与推理，对VLA中利用语言域进行高效推理或世界建模有一定方法学启示，但本身不直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型。

papers.abstract: Safe human--robot collaboration requires more than visual description: a monitor must determine whether the robot body is safely separated, already colliding with the scene or a person, or about to collide. We call this capability collision grounding: binding visual observations to robot body geometry, camera viewpoint, scene layout, human proximity, and temporal motion in order to infer present and imminent contact. We introduce TouchSafeBench, a physics-grounded benchmark for evaluating collision grounding in vision-language models (VLMs). Built in Habitat~3.0, TouchSafeBench contains 2,940 simulated indoor co-presence episodes across social navigation and social rearrangement, with synchronized multi-view RGB-D observations, top-down trajectory maps, calibrated camera metadata, and simulator-derived contact labels. We study two deployment-facing tasks: classifying the current safety state and warning about imminent collision before contact. Across three frontier or robotics-oriented VLMs and nine visual representations, current models remain far from reliable: the best average Macro-F1 stays below 50\%, explicit depth is not automatically transformed into robot-body collision evidence, and robot--scene contact is consistently harder than human-contact risk. TouchSafeBench reveals a central limitation of embodied VLMs: visual fluency does not imply physical accountability. Reliable robot safety monitors will need representations that explicitly bind viewpoint, robot morphology, metric geometry, and future collision. The benchmark is available at https://jun25336-bit.github.io/TouchSafeBench/ .

analysis.key_results: 最佳模型平均Macro-F1低于50%，显式深度并未自动转化为机器人身体碰撞证据，机器人-场景接触比人-接触风险更难检测。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入TouchSafeBench，一个基于Habitat的物理基准，用于评估VLMs在碰撞接地（当前安全状态分类和碰撞预警）上的能力。
analysis.method: 在Habitat 3.0中构建2,940个室内共处场景，提供多视角RGB-D同步观测、轨迹图和接触标签，测试三个前沿/机器人导向VLMs和九种视觉表示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出并评估用于安全人机协作的碰撞接地基准TouchSafeBench，揭示当前视觉语言模型在物理安全监控上的不足。

papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable scalable performance but face severe memory constraints on edge devices. Existing offloading strategies struggle with I/O bottlenecks due to the dynamic, low-information nature of autoregressive expert activation. In this paper, we propose to repurpose Speculative Decoding (SD) not merely as a compute accelerator, but as an informative lookahead sensor for memory management, supported by our theoretical and empirical analyses. Hence, we introduce MoE-SpAc, an MoE inference framework that integrates a Speculative Utility Estimator to track expert demand, a Heterogeneous Workload Balancer to dynamically partition computation via online integer optimization, and an Asynchronous Execution Engine to unify the prefetching and eviction in the same utility space. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that MoE-SpAc achieves a 42% improvement in TPS over the SOTA SD-based baseline, and an average 4.04x speedup over all standard baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/lshAlgorithm/MoE-SpAc .

analysis.key_results: 在七个基准测试上，MoE-SpAc比最先进的基于推测解码的基线提高了42%的吞吐量（TPS），比所有标准基线平均加速4.04倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了MoE-SpAc框架，将推测解码重新定位为内存管理的信息感知机制，结合推测效用估计器、异构工作负载均衡器和异步执行引擎。
analysis.method: 提出了MoE-SpAc框架，包含三个组件：推测效用估计器（跟踪专家需求）、异构工作负载均衡器（通过在线整数优化动态划分计算）和异步执行引擎（统一预取和驱逐于同一效用空间）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MoE-SpAc框架将推测解码用作内存管理的先行传感器，以解决边缘设备上MoE推理的内存限制和I/O瓶颈。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于MoE推理和推测解码的内存管理，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模。其推测解码技术作为独立效率方向具有参考价值，但与本网站主题无直接联系。

papers.abstract: In recent years, Orthogonal Recurrent Neural Networks (ORNNs) have gained popularity due to their ability to manage tasks involving long-term dependencies, such as the Copy-task, and their linear complexity. However, existing ORNNs utilize full precision weights and activations, which prevents their deployment on compact devices. In this paper, we explore the quantization of the weight matrices in ORNNs, leading to Quantized approximately Orthogonal RNNs (QORNNs). The construction of such networks remained an open problem, acknowledged for its inherent instability. We propose and investigate two strategies to learn QORNN by combining quantization-aware training (QAT) and orthogonal projections. We also study post-training quantization of the activations for pure integer computation of the recurrent loop. The most efficient fully-quantized models are currently the only alternatives for solving the Copy-task with 1000 timesteps. They also surpass existing quantized models on tasks requiring long-term dependencies, such as permuted MNIST as well as some Internet of Things (IoT) tasks. However, they are less effective on tasks where long short-term memory (LSTMs) and other gated RNNs outperform ORNNs.

analysis.key_results: 高效全量化模型目前是唯一能在1000时间步的Copy-task上取得成功的方案，在需要长期依赖的任务（如置换MNIST和某些物联网任务）上也超越现有量化模型，但在LSTM等门控RNN表现更好的任务上效果较差。
analysis.limitations: 在LSTM和其他门控RNN表现更优的任务上效果较差。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出两种通过结合量化感知训练和正交投影来学习量化近似正交RNN（QORNN）的策略，并研究了激活的后训练量化。
analysis.method: 量化感知训练（QAT）与正交投影结合，以及激活的后训练量化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究正交循环神经网络的量化，提出两种量化感知训练与正交投影相结合的方案，并探讨激活的后训练量化以实现纯整数计算。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文主要关注循环神经网络的量化，属于独立的模型量化研究，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域。其量化方法可能对嵌入式或资源受限的机器人策略网络具有参考价值，但尚未直接应用于机器人。
